cases.content: {{DR case status|open}} {{User:ClueBot III/DoNotArchiveUntil|1766342046}} {{drn filing editor|~2025-35909-34|18:34, 23 November 2025 (UTC)}} '''Have you discussed this on a talk page?''' Yes, I have discussed this issue on a talk page already. '''Location of dispute''' * {{pagelinks|Trie}} '''Users involved''' * {{User|Ergur}} * {{User|Katzrockso}} '''Dispute overview''' Myself and another user have spent spent more than the course of a month discussing whether the Trie article ought to use "pseudocode" (a non-standardised high-level description of an algorithm that resembles a programming language) or a proper Java implementation. This other user has justified this on the grounds of MOS:ALGO and WP:PSEUDOCODE, but as brought up by the WP:3O user involved, this alone does not bind every article to its supposed guidelines, and that my arguments should be addressed for their merits. Meanwhile, my arguments were that the Java implementation was sufficiently descriptive and simple enough for readers, fewer noise words, and can be backed up by actual demonstration by compiling said code. Then, this user began to consciously cease to respond to the talk page, despite being prompted for a response from both myself and the user from WP:3O, and as per the words of the WP:3O user, such actions were WP:STONEWALLING any changes to the article. After more than a week of silence from that user, as well as someone else who weighed in and gave an opinion favouring the other user but failed to substantiate or reason for said opinion, I invoked WP:SILENCE and proceeded with restoring my changes. However, said changes were reverted yet again, and I argue that this constitutes edit warring, as I had given ample time to respond and consistently requested actual justifications rather than deference to WP/MOS pages. '''How have you tried to resolve this dispute before coming here?''' * [[Talk:Trie#Java implementation vs "pseudocode"]] * A request at WP:3O '''How do you think we can help resolve the dispute?''' I would like either the other user to be made to engage respectably and meaningfully with the discussion at hand, or cease entirely with the dispute. I feel as if I have reasoned extensively with the other reason and implored them to see reason or at least engage with discussion meaningfully, and they have WP:STONEWALLED every attempt to do so, and it feels as if they are deliberately delaying responses to the talk page to prevent an agreeable conclusion.

cases.content: {{DR case status|closed}} {{drn filing editor|TextGardener|20:52, 20 December 2025 (UTC)}} {{collapsetop|Additional information about closed case. Italian Wikipedia is a separate encyclopedia, and discussion is not applicable to English Wikipedia. [[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] ([[User talk:Robert McClenon|talk]]) 18:07, 22 December 2025 (UTC)}} :The discussion took place on the Italian page (https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discussione:Maire_(azienda)), where it was explained that the entry was not encyclopaedic due to its unfair prominence and lack of encyclopaedic relevance, given that the dispute is still ongoing. :In support of this opinion, user @ValterVB also intervened, confirming that the changes cannot be made, as the information is not established. :Another point that makes the change unfeasible is the copy and paste used on the Italian page for Maire and on the Italian page for Tecnimont: :https://it.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Maire_(azienda)&oldid=148348395 :https://it.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tecnimont&oldid=148348526 :Regarding the accusation of undeclared conflict of interest, I would like to point out that the accusation was previously made by me to @[[User:TextGardener|TextGardener]] (here: https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discussione:Maire_(azienda)) for the following reasons: :- non-neutral writing of the paragraph, as it reported exclusively EuroChem's corporate vision :- since the Russian court ruling (28 November 2025), which has no value in the dispute with EuroChem, several press releases and content signed by EuroChem have been disseminated in Italy (e.g.: https://www.sbircialanotizia.it/2025/12/04/eurochem-chiama-in-causa-maire-dubbi-sulla-trasparenza-dei-rischi-russi/) and this activity targeting the Italian Wikipedia pages Maire and Tecnimont and the English page Maire Tecnimont could be part of the EuroChem campaign :- profile created on 3 December 2025, following the Russian ruling, with most activities related to politicians and prominent figures in Russia (EuroChem is a Russian company) :- total absence within the EuroChem pages of any mention of the dispute, sign of bad faith :The further investigation of a 2019 event with the intent to ‘damage’ Maire Tecnimont represents another potential conflict of interest, especially if Punta Catalina is involved in the Odebrecht scandal, where Maire Tecnimont was solely a project partner and has not been convicted of bribery or other offences by any court. :These aspects call into question the neutrality of the user. :Regarding the accusation made against me, when it came to a conflict of interest, I reported it, following Wikipedia's rules and listening to users' suggestions on changes and rules. :Finally, I would like to emphasise that, as demonstrated by the discussion https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discussione:Maire_(company), I am fully open to the inclusion of a section dedicated to the legal issue with EuroChem, but in the correct manner and at the correct time, which the other user did not respect: as the dispute is still ongoing, it is necessary to wait until the end of the case to include the information on Maire's page, but also on EuroChem's page. :@[[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] [[User:Msforzese|Msforzese]] ([[User talk:Msforzese|talk]]) 10:54, 22 December 2025 (UTC) {{collapsebottom}} {{DRN archive top|Closed [[without prejudice]] for two reasons. First, the filing editor has not notified the other editor '''on their user talk page'''. Notification on the article talk page is useful but not sufficient. Second, there has not been discussion on the article talk page, because the filing editor has not engaged in discussion. Discussion consists of at least two comments by each editor. The other editor has not been discussing. The filing editor should attempt to engage the other editor in discussion both on their user talk page and on the article talk page. If there is inconclusive discussion, a new case can be filed here. If the other editor continues to edit without discussing, read [[WP:DISCFAIL|the discussion failure essay]]. Disruptive editing may be reported at [[WP:ANI]] after reading [[WP:BOOMERANG|the boomerang essay]] (but failure to discuss is not in itself disruptive). [[WP:COI|Conflict of interest]] concerns may be reported at [[WP:COIN|the conflict of interest noticeboard]]. [[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] ([[User talk:Robert McClenon|talk]]) 02:00, 21 December 2025 (UTC)}} '''Have you discussed this on a talk page?''' Yes, I have discussed this issue on a talk page already. '''Location of dispute''' * {{pagelinks|Maire Tecnimont}} '''Users involved''' * {{User|TextGardener}} * {{User|Msforzese}} '''Dispute overview''' I’m seeking community input regarding a content dispute on the article Maire Tecnimont. On 5 December, I added a section about the legal dispute between the company and EuroChem. It was removed with the edit summary “Non-encyclopedic”. Immediately after that, I raised the issue on the article talk page, explaining why I believed the material was relevant and encyclopedic. I then revised the content by shortening the EuroChem section, adding Maire’s position, and including a brief reference to the Punta Catalina power plant case in the Dominican Republic. Both topics are covered by reliable secondary sources: the EuroChem dispute by English, Italian and Kazakh analytical media, and the Punta Catalina case by Dominican, Brazilian and English-language sources. Despite these revisions, the material was removed again by the same editor with the edit summary “No encyclopedic relevance”, without engagement on the article talk page. '''How have you tried to resolve this dispute before coming here?''' [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Maire%20Tecnimont https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Maire_Tecnimont] '''How do you think we can help resolve the dispute?''' Given that the current article contains very little critical content, I am seeking guidance on whether well-sourced legal controversies can be included in a concise and balanced form, and how due weight should be applied in this case.

cases.content: {{DR case status|closed}} {{drn filing editor|~2026-98445|19:58, 5 January 2026 (UTC)}} {{DRN archive top|Closed as not previously discussed and improperly filed. This filing, which has the nature of a rant, is the only edit that this unregistered editor has made. There has not been any discussion on the article talk page, which is where issues about article content should be discussed, so the article talk page would be a more appropriate place for this statement. The unregistered editor has not listed any other editors (because they haven't tried to discuss on a talk page). The unregistered editor is advised that, if they are seriously interested in changing an article, they should [[WP:REGISTER|register an account]], and, either as a registered editor or an unregistered editor, article talk pages are where article content can be discussed. [[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] ([[User talk:Robert McClenon|talk]]) 23:47, 5 January 2026 (UTC)}} '''Have you discussed this on a talk page?''' Yes, I have discussed this issue on a talk page already. '''Location of dispute''' * {{pagelinks|Oglethorpe County}} * {{pagelinks| Georgia}} '''Users involved''' * {{User|Nobody}} '''Dispute overview''' It seems to me that if you are going to dedicate a space for the "HISTORY" of Oglethorpe County, Georgia, you could at least select something that is not quite so obviously biased. Whoever made this choice had an agenda and it was not positive on anything that would make a meaningful contribution to social learning or the history of a region. It is very disappointing to see this kind of thing emphasized. Not to mention that the story that was chosen is out of context and in no way portrays the actual facts surrounding the event that is described. Please consider that someone has chosen this because this county in in Georgia and in the South. If you look at the racial killings that have happened in other parts of the country, let's say New York, you don't see this kind of thing featured and giving an intentional and biased black eye to that community. What you have allowed or chosen to do here is simply WRONG! If you consider it objectively you will recognize the error of what you have done. Please choose to do the right thing. All the good that has come out of this humble and quiet country county in Georgia does not deserve to be overshadowed by this improperly edited account of an unfurtunate event. Do the right thing!!! Then I will consider making a donation to help keep Wikipedia on the web. Until then, hell will freeze over before I give you anything. Does that sound mean spirited. It is in response to one of the most vicious things I have ever seen done in journalism. The word journalism really does not apply. Please respond to me if you like. Charlie Snelling '''How have you tried to resolve this dispute before coming here?''' I find no other way to communicate with the Foundation. '''How do you think we can help resolve the dispute?''' Take down this inaccurate and biased editorial that is intentionally smearing the good name of good people.
